source.dataset: University College Dublin Sleep Apnea Database

models.name: Feature ensemble
models.hypothesis: Can physiology-derived features classify each epoch without temporal context?

models.name: Learned context (5 epochs)
models.hypothesis: Does a compact learned probability context correct unstable epoch decisions?

models.name: 6-second dilated TCN
models.hypothesis: Can a deeper network learn useful short- and long-range structure directly?

models.name: Hierarchical epoch model
models.hypothesis: Does jointly modeling within-epoch and across-epoch structure improve generalization?

models.name: Learned context + confidence
models.hypothesis: Can wider context, logits, and confidence preserve useful uncertainty across epochs?
